title: Remove or sharpen the redundant repeated-name docs test of #226
todo:
**Problem:** `TestAmazonBrowserSnapDocs_TC002_RepeatedNameAfterTheListIsAccepted` (`internal/service/amazon_browser_snap_docs_test.go:227`) repeats `chromium` after the lookup list. `specifiedSnapSetup` already does that through `snapParagraph` (which names `chromium` and `chromium-browser`), so `TestAmazonBrowserSnapDocs_TC002_ChecksAcceptTheSpecifiedSection` already covers this case.

**Suggested work:** Either delete the test and add a comment on `ChecksAcceptTheSpecifiedSection` saying it covers names repeated after the list, or change the fixture to test something the specified fixture does not, for example a repeat of `google-chrome-stable` after the list. Run `go test ./internal/service/...` afterwards.
